resources.string: Manage Google recovery
Password recovery
Passkey recovery
A secure screen lock and account verification are required.
Google lists %1$d recovery members.
Set up recovery
Allow this phone
Replace the shared recovery key
Reset this recovery store
Allow the requested device
Create a new recovery store for this account? This cannot unlock existing data protected by a lost recovery store.
Allow this phone to recover this account using the keys you have already recovered? Your secure screen lock is required.

Replace the shared key for every recovery member shown by Google? This saves the new key before sending the request and checks the result before confirming it. Other devices must retrieve the replacement key.

Reset this account’s recovery store and remove its recovery keys and members? Existing encrypted passwords or passkeys may become inaccessible. Saved credentials remain encrypted on this phone. This cannot be undone by closing the screen.
Allow the device identified below to receive this account’s recovery keys? Continue only if you initiated this request and recognize the device.
Requested device fingerprint: %1$s
Requesting app: %1$s
The earlier request may still finish. Check its result first. A new attempt uses the same saved phone key and exact reviewed operation; it never silently resets or recreates a store.
Close this attempt
Close this attempt without undoing a request Google may already have received? The protected request and receipt remain saved.
Cancel this saved reset before sending it? Google has not received this attempt. Existing recovery keys remain available and the cancelled request stays in protected history.
Google’s current recovery state confirmed this operation.
Google confirmed the reset. Local recovery-key cleanup still needs to finish; recovery remains blocked.
The reviewed operation is saved and awaits confirmation from Google.
Google may have received the operation. Refresh to check before deciding what to do next.
The recovery store changed after you reviewed it. Refresh and review the current devices before continuing.
The operation could not be confirmed. Any pending request remains protected on this phone. Recover access with Google if the existing keys are unavailable.
